## Highlights

- Faster native pricing and analytics: European binomial pricing uses O(steps), bond duration/convexity use O(log coupon periods), IRR/XIRR use analytic derivatives, and implied-volatility solvers share cached calculations. [#82](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/82)
- Representative release workloads measured 8.2× faster European binomial pricing, 6.9× faster long-bond risk, 5.1× faster robust statistics, 5× faster Black-76 IV, 4.4× faster Bachelier IV, and 3.3× faster large-curve lookup. These are workload-specific measurements; raw timings and limitations are recorded in the [performance report](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/blob/v0.2.21/PERFORMANCE_IMPROVEMENTS.md).
- RSI retains a bounded seed history. Exact robust statistics use percentile selection; matrix-vector multiplication reads native list storage directly. [#82](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/82)

## Correctness and defaults

- Repair numerical edge cases, vectorized NULL handling, missing-data pair selection, return compounding, bond yield convergence, date overflow, and portfolio risk contributions. [#82](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/82)
- Add weekday `(date, offset)` overloads, a price-scaled Bachelier IV starting guess, and curve validation consistent with interpolation. Existing names and overloads remain available. [#82](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/82)
- Share weighted degrees-of-freedom state updates while preserving public behavior. [#81](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/81)

## Tooling and validation

- Enable DuckDB-backed PR/main/merge-queue checks, retain per-statement profiles, and add reproducible release benchmarks through `make benchmark`.
- Validation includes full sanitizer checks, the complete release gold suite, 156 additional SQL assertions, 13 Python tests, 45 direct RSI partition/merge checks, and 16 parsed operator profiles. [#82 checks](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/pull/82/checks)

## Compatibility

- Native artifacts target DuckDB v1.5.5. Community-catalog publication is a separate upstream step.
- Corrected calculations intentionally change results for missing observations, non-default degrees of freedom, and portfolio risk contributions. Invalid inputs and nonconverged solves now return NULL in documented cases; curves require finite values and strictly increasing finite knots.
- Bachelier's default guess now adapts to price scale; explicit guesses remain supported. Review these behavior corrections when upgrading.
- Forty-five functions remain experimental or use simplified models. This release documents those limitations; passing tests and faster execution do not validate every advertised model. See the [experimental catalog](https://github.com/leonardovida/duckdb-finance/blob/v0.2.21/docs/experimental_functions.md).
